items.title: 67251_Chuck Green oral history interview
items.q: With Reverend John Ginzo? That's right.

ctx.x: What happened at the funeral, Chuck?

Well, each one of us, we spoke to God footagely (unintelligible) you see by tap -- in tap dancing. Joyful noises, you see. Then we all said Amen, you see. It was like a prayer for his receivership, you see, when he get back to the Maker, you know. So -- and the Reverend Ginzo, you see, he really was the whole antidote of it all, you see, because he allows us to make these joyful noises, you know. And degree of our faiths more better, you know, because that's it, you see. They don't want us to become molested in…
